headline: Cagliari 7th, Bologna 15th — yet Bologna are the favourites
summary: Cagliari's unbeaten run ended with a 0-4 defeat at Monza on Sunday, yet they stay 7th with 13 points — a start last matched in 1969/70. On Saturday they host a Bologna side 15th on 5 points, with one win in seven league games. Bologna also lose striker Roberto Piccoli for about 3 weeks, and Italian media report Riccardo Orsolini is training alone. Even so, the market makes Bologna 38.0% favourites to win. The gap it sees is just 0.15 goals: a near-even game.
read: Cagliari have the better season — 13 points and seventh place, their best start since 1969/70 — but they host Bologna five days after a 0-4 hiding at Monza. Bologna are still the market's narrow favourite despite sitting 15th with five points and possibly missing both Piccoli and Orsolini, and a goal line of 2.25 says the market expects a tight, low-scoring game.

facts.fact: Cagliari's four-match unbeaten run ended with a 0-4 defeat away to Monza on Sunday.
facts.meaning: They host Bologna five days after shipping four, so how they respond at home is the first question of the game.

facts.fact: Bologna are the favourites at 38.0% to win at Cagliari, ahead of the draw at 32.7% and the hosts at 29.3%.
Bologna sit 15th in Serie A with five points from seven games.
facts.meaning: A bottom-half start for the side the market still favours at Cagliari.

facts.fact: Cagliari's 13 points from seven games is their best start to a Serie A season since 1969/70.
facts.meaning: The hosts arrive seventh and with genuine belief, one bad afternoon at Monza notwithstanding.

facts.fact: Bologna lost 1-3 at home to Inter on 17 October, their first defeat under Raffaele Palladino.
facts.meaning: Palladino's unbeaten start is over, and he has had seven days — more rest than Cagliari — to answer it.

facts.fact: Bologna confirmed striker Roberto Piccoli will be out for about three weeks after the injury he picked up against Inter.
facts.meaning: Bologna make the trip without a senior forward option, which sharpens the question of how they score.

facts.fact: Italian media report Riccardo Orsolini is training separately and his availability for the Cagliari match is uncertain.
facts.meaning: If he misses out, Bologna would travel without another of their attacking starters.

facts.fact: The handicap fair line is +0.15 — the market rates Bologna only a fraction of a goal better than Cagliari.

sources.fact: Cagliari's four-game unbeaten run ended with a 4-0 defeat away to Monza.
Cagliari have taken 13 points from their first seven Serie A matches, a start last matched in the 1969/70 Scudetto season.
Yael Trepy trained fully with the first team for the first time after his swimming pool accident last August.
Cagliari are continuing preparations for the Bologna match at the CRAI Sport Center, with Trepy training with the squad.
Former Cagliari staff member Fabio Bazzani says he expects an aggressive Cagliari at home after the heavy defeat to Monza.
Bologna confirmed striker Roberto Piccoli will be out for about three weeks after his injury against Inter.
Italian media report that Riccardo Orsolini is training separately and his availability for the Cagliari match is uncertain.
Bologna held a morning session at Casteldebole with treatment for Piccoli and Orsolini, whose presence is to be assessed.
